The Man in the Bog

I got this from the playing of concertina player Breda Shannon and her brother Aidan on flute from Ballinameen, Co. Roscommon. They follow it with The Munster Bacon.

http://comhaltas.ie/music/detail/comhaltaslive_262_7_breda_and_aidan_shannon

|: (3B/c/d/ |\

C: Brendan Tonra

This jig seems to be a composition of Brendan Tonra. According to the sleeve notes of Marcas O’Murchu’s first solo album, he learnt it directly from Tonra.

Whistle friendly variation

Playing EGE rather than EDB, in measures 3 and 7 sounds very natural to me -- certainly better than popping the B, up an octave. (You could also just roll the E I guess…).

↳ Posted by JBrock on April 28th, 2022.

Man In The Bog, X:8

Promoting my whistle friendly variation from a comment to a setting. Other than avoiding the low B I follow Brendan Tondra’s playing as heard in the video above, except that I’ve added a turnaround in the second part because that’s how we play it at my usual session.
